decisionMetadata.title: Optional resident service architecture boundary
decisionMetadata.suggestedDecision: Frame a proposed synthetic-only architecture for an optional resident portal and separate bounded resident-answer task; preserve the existing staff and regulatory assistant boundaries, and defer unverified provider/live-operation choices.
deciders: Programme owner (exercise architecture decision only; not company or control-owner approval)

scope: Proposed architecture decision for the optional synthetic resident portal and distinct resident communication/answer task in parallel with existing staff delivery. Compare lean architecture compositions and establish authority, data, operational and staging boundaries; do not approve production topology, provider procurement, real resident processing, live sending or implementation.
deciders: Programme owner (exercise architecture decision only; not company or control-owner approval)
drivers: Optional resident self-service must preserve accessible, assisted and non-digital parity without detriment.
Enforce current identity, case/field/task and representative grants server-side with timely revocation; login, address, relationship and consent are distinct.
Safely receive, quarantine, scan, review, publish and revoke resident documents without exposing unsafe or unpublished content.
Provide a shared, provenance-rich omnichannel case-event history and owned exception/handoff workflow without assuming connectors or exactly-once delivery.
Bound the resident-answer task to current authorized evidence, abstention and human handoff; no persistent resident memory or delegated-agent loop.
Keep per-message human review as the default; any routine-policy exception remains OFF until upstream wording and OD-53/release gates are resolved.
Make service ownership, recovery, privacy, diagnostic telemetry and whole-service cost explicit; stage reversibly and do not delay independent staff landing absent verified dependency.
Treat 60,000 homes as stock, not resident accounts; five sessions are only a proposed exercise workload. Capacity and benefit claims remain unvalidated.
constraints: BRD and PRD amendments are unsigned drafts: BRD Define BLOCKED/Govern NOT_EVALUATED; PRD Validate BLOCKED/Finalize NOT_EVALUATED. No owner signatures or approved handoff.
Resolve BRD FR-044 universal human-review wording versus AC-084 routine-policy disposition with the requirements owner; ADR cannot override it. Automation remains OFF.
OD-52 to OD-55 and OD-41/42/47 remain open as applicable; no role hypothesis supplies approval.

Preserve ADR 0001/0002 production-versus-exercise distinctions, ADR 0003 journey authority, ADR 0004 staff-only chat/memory acceptance, and ADR 0005 regulatory assistant no-send boundary; do not supersede them.

No homegrown password storage, assumed staff-directory membership, resident persistent memory, broad model/store access, production provider selection from memory, paid/tenant operation, implementation, deployment, or repository/Git/GitHub write.

Do not infer 60,000 unique accounts, five sessions as production scale, observed uptake, forecast, cash/headcount savings or ROI. Illustrative authorized judgement only: 90 new cases/week × 8 weeks = 720 active; base baseline 84 staff-hours/week; 14.74 net hours/week freed after stated assumptions; low -1.594, high 94.333.
No broad inherited requirement repairs and do not delay existing staff landing/auth absent a verified dependency.
